etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English bulki, boulky, equivalent to bulk +‎ -y.

definitions.definition: Being large in size, mass, or volume; big, fat or muscular

quote.citation: 1960 March, G. Freeman Allen, “Europe's most luxurious express - the "Settebello"”, in Trains Illustrated, page 140:
quote.text: Needless to say, one's seat must be booked in advance and a platoon of urbane officials, one to each door of the train, awaits passengers to usher them to their seats and relieve them of their bulkier baggage.

definitions.definition: (bodybuilding) Having excess body mass, especially muscle.
